candidates.name: Wegener's granulomatosis
support_spans: hemoptysis
worsening dyspnea
multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae over the trunk and extremities
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of hemoptysis, worsening dyspnea, and painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae are consistent with a diagnosis of Wegener's granulomatosis, a form of vasculitis that affects the lungs and other organs.

candidates.name: Antiphospholipid syndrome
support_spans: lupus anticoagulant was prolonged at 82 seconds
anticardiolipin IgM was 64
anti–phosphatidylserine IgM was >100
candidates.why: The patient's positive tests for lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgM, and anti–phosphatidylserine IgM are consistent with a diagnosis of antiphospholipid syndrome, a condition characterized by the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies.

candidates.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
support_spans: antinuclear antibody titer was 1:160
lupus anticoagulant was prolonged at 82 seconds
candidates.why: The patient's positive antinuclear antibody titer and prolonged lupus anticoagulant are consistent with a diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus, a chronic autoimmune disease that can affect multiple organs.

candidates.name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
support_spans: superficial and deep dermal thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy involving skin appendages
candidates.why: The patient's skin biopsy showing thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy is consistent with a diagnosis of thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, a disorder characterized by the formation of blood clots in small blood vessels.

candidates.name: Infectious mononucleosis
support_spans: Epstein-Barr virus DNA PCR was positive at 8696 copies/mL
candidates.why: The patient's positive Epstein-Barr virus DNA PCR is consistent with a diagnosis of infectious mononucleosis, a condition caused by the Epstein-Barr virus.

candidates.name: Respiratory syncytial virus infection
support_spans: A FilmArray respiratory panel was positive for respiratory syncytial virus
candidates.why: The patient's positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus is consistent with a diagnosis of respiratory syncytial virus infection, a common cause of respiratory illness.
